name: @ai-games/gen
description: Procedural generator library: mesh primitives (plane/box/uvSphere/cylinder/lathe/extrude/tube), bundle ops (computeNormals/flatShade/merge/transform/setColor), SDF combinators + surface nets mesher, seedable CPU noise (simplex/fbm/worley) with matching WGSL snippets, and vendored ZzFX audio. Depends only on @ai-games/schema. All generators must be deterministic: same inputs -> bit-identical GeometryBundles.
